brand.name: CivicNode Goa
brand.tagline: Transparent Relief. Faster Decisions. Accountable Governance.
hero.eyebrow: A clearer path to disaster relief
hero.title: Relief, Without the Wait.
hero.body: One intelligent platform connecting farmers, government officers and disaster relief services for faster, transparent and accountable decisions.
hero.proof: Built for clarity. Designed for people.
sections.howBody: One connected journey. Every check is visible, every decision stays with an officer.
sections.aiBody: Every recommendation is explainable and reviewable. No claim is automatically approved, rejected or paid by AI.
sections.floodBody: Water coverage is a signal for review—not proof of crop damage. Field confirmation remains with the officer.
sections.calculate: Know how each rupee is calculated
sections.support: Questions? We are here to help.
sections.flowBody1: A guided, multilingual application keeps the important details together.
sections.flowBody2: Document fields are extracted and compared with registry records.
sections.flowBody3: Satellite water coverage and scheme rules are surfaced with context.
sections.flowBody4: An officer reviews the evidence and records the final decision.
sections.laneExplain: Green, amber and red lanes help prioritize attention. An officer always decides.
sections.helpBody: Get help with an application, documents, accessibility or a claim update through a local assistance centre.
sections.connectedTitle: Relief should be clear at every step.
sections.connectedBody: Start a sample claim, review its evidence or explore the department view. No official affiliation is implied.

claim.title: Apply for disaster relief
claim.intro: A guided application with clear steps. Your information stays in this browser in demo mode.
claim.step1Body: Add the farmer’s contact and location details.
claim.step2Body: Use the survey details shown on the land record.
claim.step3Body: Add Form I & XIV, ownership records or other helpful evidence.
claim.step4Body: Describe what happened. An officer confirms damage.
claim.name: Farmer name
claim.landNote: Registry comparison is a review aid. Extracted values are never silently changed.
claim.uploadHelp: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to 10 MB per file
claim.uploadLimit: Up to five files · files remain in this browser in demo mode
claim.descriptionPlaceholder: Share what happened to the plot and crops…
claim.voiceNote: Record a short description. Demo transcription is simulated, editable and not sent to a voice service.
claim.transcript: Simulated transcription · please review and edit before continuing
claim.reviewBody: Check the details carefully before submitting.
claim.declaration: I confirm the information provided is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
claim.aiNotice: AI may recommend a review lane. It does not approve, reject or pay claims. An officer decides.
claim.submitError: The claim could not be submitted. Please try again.
claim.success: Your claim is in the system.
claim.successBody: Your claim was added to the shared demonstration pipeline. You can follow its progress using this reference.
csc.title: CSC Operator Mode
csc.notice: Submitting on behalf of a farmer.
csc.noticeBody: Keep the operator’s details separate from the farmer’s claim information.
status.title: Your claim journey
status.human: An officer makes the final decision.
status.awaitingUpdate: Updates will appear here as the claim progresses.
status.notFoundBody: Check the claim reference or return to the farmer portal.
status.detail1: Your application has been received and added to the claim pipeline.
status.detail2: Documents are checked for clarity and key details are extracted.
status.detail3: Land details are compared with the available registry record.
status.detail4: Satellite data indicates water coverage, not crop damage.
status.detail5: Scheme conditions are evaluated for officer review.
status.detail6: A deterministic demonstration formula calculates an indicative amount.
status.detail7: An officer reviews the evidence and any items needing attention.
status.detail8: The officer records the final decision and remarks.
status.detail9: Payment processing begins only after an officer decision.
status.detailSubmitted: The claim is in the queue for document and registry review.
status.detailInfoNeeded: The farmer needs to provide additional information before review can continue.
status.detailInspection: An officer has requested an on-site inspection. This is not a rejection.
status.detailOfficer: An officer is reviewing the evidence. AI recommendations are advisory only.
status.detailApproved: An officer approved this claim. Payment is a separate next step.
status.detailRejected: An officer recorded a decision. See the remarks for the reason.
status.detailPayment: The approved claim is moving through payment processing.
status.detailPaid: The claim is marked paid in this demonstration dataset.

verify.privacyBody: Only details needed to review this claim are requested. Aadhaar numbers and photos are not needed.
verify.accountableBody: Your submission and claim status can be followed in one place.
verify.promoTitle: A more connected way to get relief.
verify.promoBody: Verify a mobile number to keep claim updates connected to the farmer. We do not ask for Aadhaar numbers, photographs or unnecessary personal information.

landing.schemeIntro: Transparent workflows for relief and compensation claims. Scheme rules shown here are illustrative demo data, not government policy.
landing.floodSchemeBody: A clear review path for crop-loss claims after flood events, with evidence and compensation details visible to the officer.
